expectations.text: Says the book presents the ketogenic diet as a good whole-diet approach for bipolar disorder, ideally under medical supervision, and mentions keto side effects ('keto flu')
expectations.evidence: keto mentioned skeptically as promoted elsewhere; not presented as book's approach; no keto flu

expectations.text: Lists foods to embrace: omega-3 fatty fish, NAC/cysteine-rich foods, folate (B9), magnesium and zinc
expectations.evidence: omega-3, NAC/cysteine, folate, magnesium, zinc mentioned

expectations.text: States that with lithium sodium intake should be kept constant
Warns that grapefruit juice and tyramine-containing foods (aged cheese, cured meats, soy sauce, etc.) can interfere with some bipolar medications
Advises abstaining from or heavily restricting alcohol and limiting caffeine to under 400 mg/day
expectations.evidence: limit alcohol but caffeine advice is 'keep steady', no 400 mg

expectations.text: Stresses that diet complements but does not replace medication and he should not change meds without his psychiatrist
expectations.evidence: tell his psychiatrist; diet adds to treatment
